sar_selection: 10 historical + 90 uniform without replacement from remainder
potsdam_selection: All locally available paired tiles; not randomly sampled from full archive
inferential_unit: pair_id; offsets and random realizations are repeated measures; SAR parent-scene provenance unavailable
quantization: fixed [0,1] for both work-image features; no per-candidate normalization
raw_scaling: read_image normalizes each complete source image; raw work crop is not rescaled again
feature_context: once on complete work crop; central optical template; shifted target search windows
truth: dataset co-registration; no independently surveyed point truth

random_controls.pairs: historical 10 SAR and all 22 Potsdam pairs
random_controls.independence: SHA256 streams separate modalities, pairs, subbands and seeds; scales intentionally reuse paired random draws

timing.estimand: serial in-memory two-image feature extraction + joint MI/CCRE map + joint peak/metric decoding, one offset
timing.representative_pairs: first manifest pair per dataset; technical repeats are not additional image pairs
timing.main_wall_times: diagnostic only under concurrent execution, not a publication runtime benchmark
timing.feature_accounting: features are shared across offsets; each main row charges the full feature cost for a hypothetical isolated one-offset query; never sum those row costs across measures/offsets

external_baselines.pc_orientation_channels: available exploratory feature; not original HOPC and not in primary strategies
